strings.address_range: Address must be 0x%02X-0x%02X (set by the AD0/AD1 pins)
strings.init.help: Claim the part; every pin an input unless a mask says otherwise
strings.levels_not_register: These are pin levels, not the output register -- the part has none to read.
strings.levels_note: Levels were established before any pin became an output
strings.not_an_aw9523b: 0x%02X is not an AW9523B: chip ID reads 0x%02X, expected 0x23

not_initialized.text: AW9523B not initialized. Run 'i2c-aw9523b init [address]' first.

strings.pin_range: Pin must be 0-7 within the port
strings.port0_line_open_drain: Port 0: inputs 0x%02X, outputs preset to 0x%02X, open-drain (add 'pushpull' to drive high)
strings.port0_line_push_pull: Port 0: inputs 0x%02X, outputs preset to 0x%02X, push-pull
strings.port1_line: Port 1: inputs 0x%02X, outputs preset to 0x%02X, push-pull
strings.port_written: P%d driven to 0x%02X; pins configured as inputs (0x%02X) ignore it
strings.read.help: Read the pin levels of one port or both
strings.set_but_input: P%d.%d set %s, but it is configured as an input and will not drive. Re-run 'i2c-aw9523b init' with a p%din mask that clears bit %d.
strings.state_invalid: State must be 0/1, low/high, off/on or false/true
strings.unknown_option: Unknown option '%s'. Expected p0in, p1in, p0init, p1init or pushpull.
